name: Generic maneuvering body
source: GENERIC FIXTURE - not a specific vehicle.  Represents the quasi-ballistic maneuvering-body class: a non-separating unitary airframe flying a depressed trajectory (~50 km apogee, ~450-690 km range) that pulls up aerodynamically in the terminal phase at roughly Mach 6-7.  The numbers are open-source order-of-magnitude estimates for that class, not a fit to any published vehicle, and there is no measured aero or thermal data behind them.  Use it to exercise the non-separating glide path, not to characterise a real system.
notes: Reentry mode: this object was characterised flying damped_glide, which is now its shipped default reentry plan. The glide law is a reentry-plan choice (still switchable on the sidebar strip), not object hardware.
